description_expanded: ABOUT WISH YOU WERE HERE: Welcome to "Wish You Were Here," a stunning vacation rental nestled in Seacrest Beach on the coveted 30A. This spacious, beautifully designed cottage is located in the charming Cottages at Camp Creek, a community of 34 Key West-style homes situated between Seaside and Rosemary Beach along scenic County Highway 30-A. Enjoy direct access to the beach-just 400 steps from your front door via our private community access. After a day of sun and surf, retreat to the community's impressive 7,500 sq. ft. pool and heated spa for relaxation. For a cozy evening, unwind on the expansive covered porch surrounded by native trees, and cook up a delicious meal on the Ducane Weber gas grill. Our 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom cottage comfortably accommodates 7 guests. The master suite features a king bed, a full bath, a 32" Wi-Fi-enabled flat-screen TV, and ample closet space. The queen bedroom offers a 29" Wi-Fi-enabled flat-screen TV and generous closet storage. The kid-friendly bunk room includes a twin bunk bed with a pull-out trundle, a 19" flat-screen TV, DVD player, and Xbox with a selection of movies and games. Experience Coastal Bliss at "Wish You Were Here" in Seacrest Beach, Florida. "Wish You Were Here" provides all the comforts and amenities for a memorable beach getaway, ensuring that every guest feels right at home. ABOUT THE AREA: Seacrest Beach, Florida, is a charming coastal community nestled along the renowned Emerald Coast. Situated between the iconic beach destinations of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach offers a tranquil escape with easy access to the area's vibrant attractions and natural splendor. Beyond its breathtaking beaches, Seacrest Beach boasts a laid-back atmosphere and a sense of community that is both welcoming and inclusive. Stroll along the cobblestone streets lined with quaint cottages and lush landscaping, and you ll discover a thriving village center brimming with boutiques, cafes, and restaurants. From eclectic eateries serving up fresh seafood to charming shops offering unique souvenirs and artisanal goods, there is something to delight every palate and preference. For those seeking outdoor recreation, Seacrest Beach offers a wealth of options to explore its natural beauty. Take a leisurely bike ride along scenic trails, meander through the unique shops and boutiques, or embark on a sunset hike to catch breathtaking views of the coastline. Nearby state parks and nature preserves provide opportunities for birdwatching, wildlife spotting, and immersive encounters with the area's diverse ecosystems. In addition to its natural attractions, Seacrest Beach hosts a variety of events and activities throughout the year, from live music performances and art festivals to farmers markets and community gatherings. Whether you are a year-round resident or a visitor seeking a memorable vacation, there's always something exciting happening in Seacrest Beach. BEACH ACCESS: * Community Access | 8858 E County Highway 30A PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Community Pool * Pet Friendly PARKING: * Parking for 2 vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * No smoking allowed * If you choose to bring your dog, there is an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $250 per dog. The fee is to be charged after reservation confirmation. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. *Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to the properties we manage may go under construction without being notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.
